propositions: rebar_repo function-scoped fixture runs 306ms per test (mkdir, git init, git config, rebar.init_repo, git commit) across 589 tests, consuming 47% of tests/interfaces tier wall-clock; spawn count (58 per invocation) dominates user time

session-scoped template built once per xdist worker and copied per test via shutil.copytree reduces 306ms to 22.3ms (13.7x speedup) if four sharing axes are closed: worktree pointers, gate snapshot store keying, environment identity, and module-global cache

worktree pointer paths (.tickets-tracker/.git and .git/worktrees/*/gitdir) embed template absolute path and must be rewritten per copy; bare git worktree repair is a silent no-op that leaves copy attached to template store
snapshot store keys by commit SHA alone, causing ~150 tests to collide on one SHA entry and share refs; REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR must be set per-test directory
.env-id and .signing-key are uuid4 constants copied verbatim and must be re-randomized unconditionally (not via idempotency-guarded init._gen_local_files) after each copy
tier-wide autouse guard must reject any REBAR_ROOT where git worktree list --porcelain paths resolve outside REBAR_ROOT, catching half-fixed copies and stale pointer bugs
